## 0. Scope reconciliation (read this first)

The mission text is the 0.6.51 / PE-27→PE-38 audit brief, but the immutable target is PR 332, whose delta is the VNext integration. I verified the relationship rather than assuming it:

- Base is `main` at Oct 7 23:59 (merge of #331, application work).
- The 0.6.51 determinism *sources* are **unchanged** by this PR: `2026-09-29_PROTOCOL_DETERMINISM_MATRIX.md`, `..._AUDIT.md`, `KODJO_PROTOCOL_V2_SPEC_0.6.51.md`, `PROTOCOL_EVOLUTION_BACKLOG.md`, `normative-inputs.json`, `verify-independent-protocol-audit.js` — empty diff.
- But the determinism *implementation* is introduced **by this candidate**: `plan-contract.js`, `impact-graph.js`, `requirement-registry.js`, `review-contract.js`, `revision-contract.js`, `ui-atomicity-contract.js`, `planning-envelope.js` are all `ABSENT_AT_BASE`.

So the 64-row matrix audit is live on this delta, not a re-read of inherited code. 862 files, 601,142 insertions. Candidate classifies `RUNTIME_PROTOCOL_CHANGE`, `full_windows_required=true`.

## A. Matrix coverage

64/64 IDs addressed: **56 COVERED, 7 PARTIAL, 1 NOT_COVERED, 0 NON_VERIFIABLE**. Per-ID evidence is in the machine block (§F); the substantive results:

**The central determinisation is real, not cosmetic.** Three mechanisms carry it:

1. **Closed candidate sets (P-02/P-03/P-04/P-11).** `buildCandidateManifest` derives every candidate from `git ls-tree -r -z`; the model emits only `candidate_id`s, never paths. `validateCandidateManifest:154-159` recomputes each ID from its path, and `normalizeClassification:354` refuses any unknown ID. A path cannot be invented. CREATE is confined to `CREATE_ROOTS`, must be absent at HEAD, and binds `policy_id`+`policy_hash` into the ID.
2. **Derived identities and mechanical verdicts (P-08/P-15/P-20/T-13/DET-08).** `reviewerOutputSchema` exposes **no verdict field**; `review-contract.js:475-481` computes it. `assertion_id` carries no list index, closing the positional-identity defect (A01/F-09). `device_gate_required` is derived and `effectiveDeviceGate` can only escalate.
3. **Rebuild equality everywhere.** Every contract has a `validate*` that reconstructs from its declared inputs and compares canonically. This is what makes "the model cannot alter a machine fact" (T-11/DET-07) structurally true rather than asserted.

PARTIAL rows (P-05, D-03, D-11, T-10, T-16, T-17, DET-09) are bounded residues; the four deferrals in `audit-deferrals.json` carry their source priority. DET-10 is NOT_COVERED and explicitly DEFERRED — the regex resolver remains.

## B. Findings

### IA-001 · MAJOR · faux-déterminisme / unproven at scale — review coverage attested by full-catalog echo

- **File** `scripts/kodjo/lib/review-contract.js:444-445` (with `collectTargets:98`)
- **Pre-existing rule** The matrix's own non-regression principle: *«La déterminisation ne doit jamais … reconstituer un path, ID ou ensemble déjà fourni par une source déterministe.»*
- **Scenario on this HEAD** `collectTargets` pushes **every** candidate into `target_catalog.CANDIDATE`, and line 445 fails `VNEXT_REVIEW_COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE` unless `reviewed_target_ids` equals the whole catalog. The nominal chain builds the manifest on the full application tree (`vnext-live-chain.js:122`, `application_head`). Measured at this HEAD: `candidate_count = 2259`, `JSON.stringify(ids).length = 72289` bytes — before UNIT/REQ/IMP/TEST/PROOF ids.
- **Observed vs expected** Expected: coverage derived from deterministic inputs. Observed: the reviewer must re-emit ~72 KB of IDs it was just handed; a single omission hard-fails the entire review.
- **Why it is not proven** The only executed review, `evidence/37516102783/plan-review.json`, ran at `CAND=187` (419 targets total). No executed proof exists at application scale. No output cap would reject 72 KB (`maxBuffer` 64 MB), so I do **not** claim a demonstrated failure — hence MAJOR, not BLOCKING.
- **Required correction** Derive coverage mechanically (reviewer attests only the semantic residue) **or** scope the reviewable catalog to plan-relevant candidates (`write_scope ∪ preserve_scope ∪ impacted`) instead of the whole tree.
- **Non-regression test** A review at ≥2000 candidates must complete; plus a negative test that an omitted *relevant* target is still refused.

### IA-002 · MINOR · documentation — normative inventory omits the governing VNext corpus

`normative-inputs.json` and `PACKAGE_MANIFEST.md` (both modified or consumed by this candidate) do not list `KODJO_PROTOCOL_VNEXT_SPEC.md` (85 KB, the governing spec), the anti-regression matrix, or the historical disposition/equivalence contracts. `classifyPath('.github/orchestration/KODJO_PROTOCOL_VNEXT_SPEC.md')` returns `UNKNOWN`; 559 files in this diff classify `UNKNOWN`. Consequence is bounded — `UNKNOWN` outranks `NORMATIVE` in the precedence list and forces `full_windows_required=true`, so routing stays **fail-safe** — but A04/F-09 and A06/IA-004 asked for a complete versioned manifest and the VNext corpus is still outside it. `PACKAGE_MANIFEST.md` also now carries the heading *«Dépendances conservées pour l'intégration VNext»* **twice** (lines 185 and 234).

### IA-003 · MINOR · hardening — first-occurrence machine-block extraction persists on four consumed paths

All VNext extractors enforce exactly-one (`review-findings.js:11-13`, `verify-plan-closure-review.js:14`, `vnext-figma-launch.js:19`, `verify-independent-protocol-audit.js:31`). Four consumers still use `.match()` (first occurrence): `recover-published-plan.js:98,100,122`, `verify-global-requalification-state.js:8`, `build-planning-context.js:105,111`, `resolve-stable-environment-sync.js:20` — reachable from `kodjo-slice-finalize.yml`, `kodjo-v2-slice-plan.yml` and `kodjo-slice-implementation-review.yml`. In `verify-global-requalification-state.js` a decoy first block with a foreign `slice_id` would `continue` past the guard (fail-open). I rate this MINOR, not MAJOR: the consumed bodies are workflow-composed and gated on `github-actions[bot]` + an exact prefix, and no workflow currently *publishes* `TARGETED_VALIDATION_OUTPUT` — I could not demonstrate a reachable injection.

### IA-004 · MINOR · generality — closure is pinned to one campaign

`vnext-github-closure.js:7-15` hardcodes `slice_id === 'VNEXT-12-QUALIF'`, `campaign_id === '628b3349-…'` and `pr.base.ref === 'protocol/vnext-proof-stability-20260930'`. PE-30's ACTIVE→CLOSED capability is delivered as a single-use certified instance; any other slice is refused with `VNEXT_GITHUB_CLOSURE_CONFIG_REFUSED`. The closure itself is correctly **idempotent** and evidence-bound (comment-presence checks, re-observation, `VNEXT_GITHUB_CLOSURE_RECORD_CONFLICT`).

## C. Faux déterminismes

Only one survives verification: **IA-001**. I specifically attacked and *cleared* the others on the mission's list — `modified_modules` cannot carry an invented path (§A.1); scan classification keys are imposed by the manifest; UI/assertion/requirement/finding IDs are all derived; `scope_allow` has a single opposable source (`write_scope` + `verify-staged-scope.js` exact bidirectional match); `plan_status` and both verdicts are mechanical.

## D. Sur-déterminisation

None found. Product decisions stay human: a `PRODUCT_AMBIGUITY` finding forces `CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED`, an `AMBIGUOUS` unit forces registry `BLOCKED`, and `VISUAL_COMPARE`/`DEVICE_CHECK` remain `PENDING_DEVICE` with no automated PASS path (`device-proof-policy.js:4-7`). `vnext-finalization.js:51-63` binds the user's decision comment **verbatim** with exact head/slice/review-id, so a generic PASS cannot be substituted. IA-001 is the inverse error — mechanical work pushed onto the model.

Register families closed with proof: **RUNTIME** (A06/IA-001, IA-002, A07/F-001) — `run-queued-request.ps1:83-85` copies all of `scripts/kodjo` recursively before `git switch --detach`, giving complete transitive closure. **WRITERS** (A08/F-02) — REST `contents`/Git-data detection for `gh api` and literal `fetch`, declared writers pinned by exact source SHA-256. **COMPOSANTS** (A08/F-01, F-08) — `resolveSpecifier` resolves `dir/index`, tries `@/assets/` before `@/`, and fails `PLAN_SCAN_PATH_AMBIGUOUS` rather than silently taking the first. **SOURCES** (A01/F-15) — `source-manifest.js` alone does not verify locators, but the executed chain does: `observeSources:79-82` reads the real Git blob and refuses on `VNEXT_SOURCE_OBSERVATION_HASH_MISMATCH` / `..._UNIT_OBSERVATION_MISMATCH`, with `unitText` accepting only `FULL_FILE` or an in-range `Lx-Ly`. **FRONTIERES** (A07/F-004) — `coverage()` computes `cumulative_files` from `baselineHead`, not the last increment; `ALL_OUTSIDE_WRITE_SCOPE` + exact index match covers A07/F-005's "must stay absent". **REVISION** (A01/F-12, A06/IA-009) — `revision-contract.js:283-303` authorizes only blocking targets plus declared dependencies, refuses an unanchored `PLAN_CONTRACT` root, and hash-locks every preserved target. **AUDIT_GATE** (A01/F-10, A03/F-06, A07/F-012) — `await_qualified_head` now covers `workflow_dispatch` too, verifies `pr.head.sha == candidate_sha`, and requires both `protocol` and `protocol-windows-preflight` to be `success` on the exact HEAD. **AUDIT_READONLY** (A04/F-11, A05/F-13) — top-level `contents: read`; `GH_TOKEN` removed before the Claude call; mutation checked *before* report validation and again after; write permissions isolated in `publish-evidence`. **PE-36** (A06/IA-003) — `check-artifact-budget.js` gates before the costly call.

One register claim I **refute**: A04/F-03 ("present-but-invalid recovery artifact tolerated"). The two outcomes are in fact distinguished — download failure yields `status=NON_CERTIFIED` / `HISTORICAL_RECOVERY_ARTIFACT_UNAVAILABLE` via `record-unavailable-recovery.js:10-11`, while a refused certification leaves `status=FAIL`. I verified this before asserting a finding, and withdrew it.

`continue-on-error` audit: 20 occurrences, none on a critical proof. The two on the current path (`kodjo-vnext-historical-checks.yml:276,285`) guard an optional historical download explicitly bounded as non-gating by `CHANGE_REPORT_0.6.51.md`, and absence is still recorded as a FAIL proof.

## Delivery

Per §1 of the mission I remained strictly read-only — the checkout is unmodified (`git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all` empty). `DELIVERY_REPORT_GATE` is satisfied by the orchestration's `publish-evidence` job, which commits this report to `.github/orchestration/reports/YYYY-MM-DD_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT_<run_id>_<attempt>.md` on `evidence/kodjo-independent-audits` without moving the audited HEAD, then re-reads the commit and PR comment. Path, commit hash and Git state come from that receipt, not from me.

APPROVE is given because no blocking finding survives verification. IA-001 is a real, demonstrated defect and should be scheduled — it is non-blocking only because I could not demonstrate a failure at scale, and the capability is correspondingly **not proven** above 187 candidates. Per the mission, nothing here extrapolates unexecuted Linux, GitHub or device behaviour, and no qualification is presented as proof of the real path.
